decision: Allow setup-only retry; no agent attempt occurred, no patch or model outcome selected against.
diagnosis: Unix-socket readiness can precede network readiness during PostgreSQL initialization; TCP-specific readiness gate introduced. Original DB logs unavailable because cleanup already removed that container; diagnosis is a supported failure hypothesis, not a proven SQL error.
runner_change: TCP readiness and database-log preservation only; packages, model, task, timeout and allocation unchanged.
